scope: Synthetic durable notebook exchanges through InMemorySyncTransport. No CloudKit, network latency, real app data, debounce, background scheduling, rendering, or editor flush. Markdown publication measured separately.
method: Three sequential repetitions per case, Release, warm filesystem caches. No concurrent local builds or test suites during measurements. Fictional fixtures regenerated between runs; actor IDs and catalog values may vary. Generation and copying excluded. p95 is the maximum of three samples, not a population estimate.
baseline_context: Baseline follows PR #146 unchanged catalog-seed reuse. The two additional benchmark phases are already present in baseline commit 4d222c4.
